notes_for_editor: Only two FFLA listings (standing, coordinates), a Wikipedia community page and a WXPR statewide article. Web searches found no construction or operating history. A Historical Society search turned up a different tower (Iron River, Bayfield County, 1934) and a TowerDex communications structure in Iron Belt; neither is the lookout and neither is used. The FFLA Wisconsin condition-report PDFs for 2017 to 2025 (cached) were searched for all three names and do not mention Iron Belt. Whether Iron Belt was a DNR tower is unknown, so the 2015 closure is not applied to it. 'Standing' is the listing only, not a site check.
